_comment: Pinned runtime of Descall Node, bundled by tools/package_runtime.py (CI). node: the official win-x64 node.exe, sha256 from https://nodejs.org/dist/<version>/SHASUMS256.txt (backend engines: node 24.x). cloudflared: GitHub release asset cloudflared-windows-amd64.exe; the build checks it against the release's published sha256 digest and, once pinned here, against this value too (set sha256 to the value the build log prints).
